APEX / WORLD SUPERBIKE · THE WORLD SUPERBIKE EDITION

An independent, fan-made record of the Superbike World Championship from its first season in 1988. Every result, calendar and published standing is transcribed from Wikipedia’s season articles (CC BY-SA 4.0), with circuit outlines from OpenStreetMap; nothing from the series’ own results service or artwork is carried. Blank cells stay blank. Latest included race: 27 September 2026. This is a dated snapshot, not a live feed.
